releases.title: Bundesliga Early Season Success in U.S. Buoyed by On-Field Excitement, In-Market Commitment, Increased Broadcast Distribution
releases.body:
• Total audience and average match audience in the U.S. for matchdays 1-9 is up 61% year-over-year
  • Early 2026-27 season success highlighted during Der Klassiker weekend (Oct. 30-Nov. 1) as total U.S. audience was nearly one million viewers, up 131% from last year's Klassiker
  • Results underscore league's long-term commitment to market in collaboration with new media rights partners USA Sports (on USA Network and Fandango) and NBCUniversal's Telemundo

NEW YORK, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Bundesliga returns to action following the final international window of 2026 as the league embarks on its last stretch of matchdays before the holidays and winter break, and audiences in the U.S. are loving what they're seeing so far.

Germany's top men's soccer league has seen a 61% year-over-year increase in total audience and average match audience in the U.S. for matchdays 1-9 so far through the 2026-27 season.

The early season success was highlighted during Der Klassiker weekend (Oct. 30-Nov. 1) with a total U.S. audience of nearly one million, up 131% YoY from last year's fall Klassiker weekend, the league's marquee matchup between FC Bayern Munich and Borussia Dortmund.

"The strong start to the season demonstrates the momentum the Bundesliga continues to build in the U.S. and the impact of our collaboration with USA Sports and NBCUniversal's Telemundo," said Robin Austermann, Bundesliga Americas Executive Vice President. "By expanding distribution, investing in local content and creating new opportunities for fans to engage with the league, we are bringing the Bundesliga closer to U.S. audiences than ever before. This is an exciting foundation to build on as we continue growing the league's relevance and fanbase in the market."

The league's growth is attributed to a combination of on-field excitement, a long-term commitment to the U.S. market, and increased visibility through a new multi-year broadcast distribution strategy making the Bundesliga available in more than 80 million homes across the U.S. on USA Network and Telemundo, plus live streaming for free via Fandango.

On the field, FC Bayern and BVB are currently tied atop the table with 21 points apiece with SC Freiburg (19 points) and RB Leipzig (18 points) hot on their heels. While Harry Kane has four goals in nine matches for the defending champions, the recently crowned Ballon d'Or winner is currently tied for the most league assists with seven, proving that he does more than score goals.

Throughout the season, the Bundesliga has worked closely with USA Sports and Telemundo to expand coverage and deepen fan engagement through on-site reporting from Germany, regular player interviews, localized content formats and dedicated club storytelling initiatives such as "Discover a Club." These efforts complement the increased distribution footprint and provide U.S. audiences with greater access to the league, its players and its culture.

Bundesliga Americas, the league's in-market operation, has been able to leverage the on-field excitement and drama to still engage fans thousands of miles away from the action. Launched in Sept. 2024 through a 17-year collaboration with Relevent, Bundesliga Americas has significantly expanded its local operations, including the creation of a dedicated content studio in Guadalajara, Mexico, while investing in local content, talent, events and fan engagement initiatives across the region.

That all-encompassing strategy was on full display during Der Klassiker weekend. Bundesliga Americas hosted a Halloween-themed Bundesliga Haus watch party event in Chicago on Oct. 31, which included broadcaster integration/promotion and live hits, appearances from World Cup winner Jürgen Klinsmann and former WWE superstar Sheamus, as well as a live recording of the Bundesliga Haus podcast.

The weekend was further enhanced by an innovative Playmobil-inspired alternate broadcast of FC Bayern vs. Dortmund on Fandango, powered by official real-time match data and designed to engage new and younger audiences through a unique virtual viewing experience.

The Bundesliga returns to action this week as FC Bayern hosts 1. FC Köln at 2:30pm ET Friday (USA Network, Universo, Peacock). Bundesliga matches in the U.S. are available on USA Network and Fandango in English and across Telemundo, Universo and Peacock in Spanish.

Bundesliga Americas

Michael LoRé

mlore@relevent.com

releases.title: Canadian Newcomers Adopt AI and Short-Form Video at Nearly Double the Rate of Canadian-Born Residents, Finds Latest MTM Report
releases.body:
OTTAWA, ON, Oct. 15, 2026 /CNW/ -- As immigration continues to drive Canadian population growth, understanding how newcomers engage with media and technology is essential for organizations navigating this shifting market.

The MTM Newcomers has released its 2026 data, focusing on the media behaviors, technology adoption, and settlement activities of individuals who have arrived in Canada within the past five years.  Our latest data highlights the evolving landscape of an expanding demographic that currently accounts for nearly one-quarter of the national population.

Highlights from the 2026 MTM Newcomers season include:
  • Widespread Adoption of Short-Form Video: Nine in ten newcomers watch short-form vertical video across platforms like YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Snapchat Spotlight, and TikTok. Newcomers are nearly 50% more likely to watch short-form video than are Canadian-born respondents, showing double the likelihood to use YouTube Shorts and five times the likelihood to use Snapchat Spotlight.
  • High Engagement with Artificial Intelligence: Four-fifths of newcomers use AI tools, which is nearly double the rate observed among Canadian-born respondents. International students and temporary workers show the highest adoption levels, leveraging a wider variety of AI platforms including Claude, DeepSeek, Perplexity, and Meta AI at more than double the rate of Canadian-born users.
  • Personal Connections Drive Consumer Choices: Newcomers rely heavily on personal recommendations when selecting essential services. They are nearly eight times as likely to choose a grocery store based on word-of-mouth from people they know, twice as likely to choose a cellphone provider based on a recommendation, and four times as likely to pick a provider where an acquaintance works.
